metric_rationale: This metric isolates the specific incongruent trials where Tallying and Weighted Additive (WADD) make opposing predictions. In these trials, one option has more positive features (favored by Tallying) while the other option has fewer features but with much higher validities (favored by WADD). The metric calculates the proportion of choices on these trials that align with the Tallying prediction (choosing the option with more features). Tallying will produce a high value near 1.0, whereas WADD will produce a low value near 0.0.

This metric calculates the proportion of choices favoring the option with fewer, but highly valid features ([1, 1, 0, 0, 0]) over the option with more, but less valid features ([0, 0, 1, 1, 1]). WADD is expected to prefer the former due to its high validity sum, resulting in a metric value > 0.5. Tallying will strictly prefer the latter because it counts 3 features against 2, resulting in a metric value < 0.5.
